Who is Punjab GK study material for?

Best book for Punjab Police, PSSSB and Punjab PCS preparation.

What does Punjab GK study material cover?

Punjab history, culture, literature, geography and economy organised into five categories, in Punjabi and English, with a practice set under every chapter.

Which exams is Punjab GK study material useful for?

Punjab Police, PSSSB, Punjab Civil Services, Patwari, General competitive.
